# Using Unslop Interface in Codex

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Codex.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.agents/skills/unslop-interface/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.agents/skills/unslop-interface/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness codex --skill unslop-interface
node packages/cli install --harness codex --skill unslop-interface --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Codex loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the unslop-interface skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.agents/skills/unslop-interface` for a project install, or `~/.agents/skills/unslop-interface` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `unslop-interface` is listed.

## Notes

- Scan paths come from community guides; /etc/codex/skills is the admin location. Codex configuration lives in ~/.codex.
- Documentation: [Codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills) (path source: community).
